title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Tier Entitlements Matrix
content:
Each ClearPath Managed IT Services tier carries a fixed set of entitlements. The matrix below states, for every tier, which kinds of work are covered work and which account-team services come with the tier.

## Covered work by tier

| Tier | Covered remote help desk work during coverage hours included in the seat fee | Microsoft 365 tenant administration (user, mailbox and license changes) is covered work | Liaison with the client's line-of-business software vendors and ISP is covered work | Firewall, switch and wireless configuration changes are covered work |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor | No | No | No | No |
| ClearPath Essentials | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| ClearPath Standard | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| ClearPath Professional | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| ClearPath Premier | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| ClearPath Enterprise | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Account-team entitlements by tier

| Tier | Strategic technology business reviews with a virtual CIO included per contract year | A named client success manager is assigned | A named technical account manager is assigned | Monthly security awareness training and phishing simulation for all seats is included |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor | 0 | No | No | No |
| ClearPath Essentials | 1 | No | No | No |
| ClearPath Standard | 2 | No | No | Yes |
| ClearPath Professional | 4 | Yes | No | Yes |
| ClearPath Premier | 4 | Yes | No | Yes |
| ClearPath Enterprise | 12 | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Points read from the matrix

- ClearPath Monitor carries none of the covered-work entitlements: on that tier help desk work, Microsoft 365 tenant administration, vendor and ISP liaison and network device changes are all outside the entitlements.
- ClearPath Essentials covers Microsoft 365 tenant administration and firewall, switch and wireless changes, but not vendor and ISP liaison.
- From ClearPath Standard upward every covered-work entitlement is included, together with security awareness training.
- A named client success manager comes with ClearPath Professional, ClearPath Premier and ClearPath Enterprise; a named technical account manager only with ClearPath Enterprise.
